description:
1. Read memory/inner-state.json, memory/habits.json, memory/drive.json, and all 7 diary entries in memory/diary/ to identify triggers.
2. Detect Hard Triggers: (a) verbosity correction was received explicitly on 2026-02-22 and 2026-02-24 (≥2 times = Hard Trigger threshold met), and (b) approval-seeking behavioral shift observed across multiple diary entries.
3. Apply the Quality Gate to candidate SELF.md entries: check Specificity (reference concrete correction events), Evidence (diary sessions), Novelty (must not duplicate the last 3 existing entries — notably 'completeness over brevity' already exists, so the new verbosity entry must be more specific/evidence-based), and Usefulness.
4. Write new dated entries to memory/SELF.md under the correct sections: at minimum a Tendencies entry about verbosity with evidence, and an Evolution entry about the approval-seeking shift. All entries must use [YYYY-MM-DD] format.
5. Update memory/habits.json: habit-001 (verbosity, strength=3) must have its status updated from 'active' to indicate it has crystallized into a tendency (per the SKILL.md rule: patterns with strength >= 3 crystallize during weekly review).
6. MUST NOT create or modify memory/SOUL.md — the foundational identity document is never auto-modified.
